assessment_summary:
0001: Justified: the Heawood graph is the Fano-plane incidence graph, its full group has order 336, and adding a clique on one bipartition class leaves precisely the bipartition-preserving group PSL(2,7).
0002: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0003: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0004: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0005: No mathematical inference; this is only a figure caption.
0006: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0007: Justified as an introduction to the equivalent Fano-plane description.
0008: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0009: Justified: the seven points and seven lines give fourteen vertices.
0010: Justified: these are exactly the incidence edges of the Heawood graph.
0011: Justified: these clique edges distinguish the point class from the line class.
0012: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0013: Justified: Fano-plane collineations preserve all specified edges, while the two vertex classes have different degrees, excluding point-line dualities and other class-swapping automorphisms.
0014: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0015: No substantive claim beyond announcing the lower-bound argument.
0016: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0017: Justified in substance: PSL(2,7) cannot embed in S_n for n≤6 by Lagrange's theorem, and the asserted exhaustive check of all 1044 unlabeled seven-vertex graphs excludes n=7, although the computation is not exhibited.
0018: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0019: Justified: an order-seven permutation on 8–13 vertices has exactly one nontrivial seven-cycle, and PSL(2,7) has distinct order-seven subgroups from which σ and τ may be chosen.
0020: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0021: Justified: A and B intersect because each has size seven while the graph has at most thirteen vertices; hence ⟨σ,τ⟩ is transitive on A∪B, every outside vertex has uniform adjacency to that union, and automorphisms of the induced subgraph extend by fixing the outside vertices.
0022: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0023: Justified as an exhaustive first case of the dichotomy A=B or A≠B.
0024: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0025: Incorrect: two seven-cycles are even, so they cannot generate S7; the omitted possible large group is A7. The correct classification here is cyclic of order 7, PSL(2,7), or A7, so the classification asserted in this step is false even though replacing S7 by A7 would repair the ensuing conclusion.
0026: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0027: Not established as written because it relies on step 0025; after correcting that classification, σ and τ generate Aut(G), fix the complement of A pointwise, and the restriction/extension argument would indeed produce a seven-vertex graph with automorphism group PSL(2,7).
0028: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0029: Justified as the complementary case A≠B.
0030: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0031: Justified: complementing preserves the automorphism group; τ fixes v and cycles B, while σ fixes w and cycles A, yielding all edges between A∖B and B.
0032: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0033: Not justified as written: step 0031 gives a complete bipartite graph between A∖B and B, not between A∖B and A∪B. The intended conclusion can be repaired by using A∩B and the fact that every nonzero cyclic difference modulo 7 must cross the nontrivial partition A=(A∖B)∪(A∩B), followed by the symmetric argument for B.
0034: No mathematical claim; blank line.
0035: Conditionally justified after repairing step 0033: if H is complete on at least eight vertices, Aut(H) has at least 8! elements, all extend by step 0021, contradicting |PSL(2,7)|=168.
